description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) setup, including initialization, setup, teardown, and protocol-specific configurations for serial, PPPoE, PPPoA, and PPTP connections within OpenWrt network services.

methods.name: ppp_select_ipaddr
methods.description: Selects the appropriate IP address from a list of subnets based on subnet masks.

methods.name: ppp_exitcode_tostring
methods.description: Converts PPP exit codes to human-readable string descriptions.

methods.name: ppp_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPP connection with provided configuration and options.

methods.name: ppp_generic_teardown
methods.description: Tears down PPP connection and handles error notifications.
